# Questions people ask

## What does membership cost?

It is £4 each club night. A year costs £35.

## Is there parking?

Yes, the community centre has a free car park behind the building.

## Do you play in a league?

Yes. We have two teams in the county league. Matches are on Tuesdays.

## When is the club open?

Thursday evenings, 7pm until 10pm.
